items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for the map A = Z[x_1,...,x_n] -> B = Z sending each x_i to 0, with I = (x_1,...,x_n), the cotangent complex L_{B/A} is quasi-isomorphic to I/I^2[1] (source lines 2889-2895). The proof uses the fundamental distinguished triangle for the composition Z -> Z[x_1,...,x_n] -> Z: the first term is computed by the polynomial algebra lemma as the module of differentials of the polynomial ring base changed to Z, the middle term L_{Z/Z} vanishes by the vanishing lemma, so the long exact sequence shows that L_{B/A} has a single nonzero cohomology group, which the surjection lemma identifies as I/I^2 in degree -1.
